title: A get/list refresh during a new evaluator's first-brief acknowledgement marks it Failed ("child finished without a result packet") before its first turn
outcome: While a freshly spawned evaluator's first turn is still being admitted (between DelegationCreated and start_delegation_child_turn in create_delegation_with_evaluation_target, src/delegations.rs), a delegation refresh reports it as pending start, as it already does for follow-ups awaiting their first turn. It no longer judges the Idle, runtime-less child as IdleWithoutResult and fails the delegation. A successful request therefore never answers Spawned for a delegation that a concurrent read already failed.
acceptance: A deterministic test holds the first-brief acknowledgement, calls get_delegation (or list_delegations) in that window, and shows the delegation stays Running and pending start. After the acknowledgement succeeds, the first turn starts and the response is Spawned for a Running delegation.
On unchanged code, the same test shows the delegation turned Failed with "child finished without a result packet" and the first-turn start refused.
